gaia_file_semantics: Raw uncompressed FITS bytes despite filename; source_id, GSP-Spec Teff/logg/MH/alpha and percentile bounds plus flags. No Fe/M column.

known_desi_fit_primary_overlap.scope: Intersection with DESI census FIT identities only, not all Gaia FIT stars.

quality_tier: Provisional: target-specific broadening and RV flags <=1; noise <=3; extrapolation <=2; negative flux <=1; NaN flux/emission/null-flux-error flags zero; broad 2500--10000 K and -1--6.5 dex sanity checks. Alpha additionally requires KMgiantPar=0 and all atmospheric broadening/RV flags <=1. Raw values are retained. These choices are exploratory, not a validated survey calibration.

sample_archive_check.scope: Three first FITS rows matched the public Gaia DR3 TAP values and full quality flags; this does not certify every catalogue row or original publisher provenance.

scope: Source-only exploratory tier, not final label validity, independent truth, full FIT union, model performance or recommended science cut.
